recommended_approach: Mantaflow GAS Domain fire/smoke with mesh Flow emitter(s) placed at the ember bed and log-contact area, plus stone/log Effector geometry inside the domain; optionally layer a separate Particle System for sparks/embers.

key_parameters.empty_space: use as an optimization control for rendering/cache size after the look is established

warnings: Flow objects must be contained within the Domain bounding box to affect the simulation.
A fluid simulation requires a Domain, and at least one Flow object is required.
The domain must have a material assigned for rendering.
When fire emission is used, the domain auto-creates some smoke from burnt fuel, so even a clean-burning campfire may need smoke tuning/dissolve control.
If delete_in_obstacle is enabled, any fluid volume intersecting obstacle geometry inside the domain is removed.
empty_space changes what is treated as empty volume, affecting render optimization and OpenVDB cache size.
alternative_approaches: Layer a Particle System emitter for sparks/embers above the ember bed and cache it over frames 1-90, while keeping Mantaflow for the main flames/smoke.
